data.narrative:
Relativity Space is a private-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Tim Ellis and Jordan Noone that has raised $1.335B to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though meaningful peer-set filtration by stage and valuation tier yields insufficient datapoints for robust median benchmarking.

Two standard triangulation methods prove inapplicable here. Peer-Median analysis fails because the 14 same-sector peers do not yield ≥3 datapoints when filtered by stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier criteria. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot proceed because Relativity Space's revenue is not disclosed—a standard constraint for private companies—while the Space & Aerospace sector median P/S multiple stands at 26.4x across the 6 public tickers identified. Without the target's top-line revenue figure, applying sector multiples would be speculative.

The absence of both applicable triangulation methods means no quantitative valuation range can be supported by this dataset. Further analysis would require either: disclosure of Relativity Space's revenue or near-term revenue guidance, or identification of sufficiently similar private-market comparables with known valuations at comparable funding stages. The $1.335B raised provides a floor reference only; it does not establish fair value.
